answer.method: Analytic power calculation using the noncentral t distribution, verified with base R's power.t.test() function. The test assumes equal variances (pooled t-test), independent observations from normal populations, and a one-sided alternative hypothesis (H₁: μ₁ > μ₂).

# Two-sample t-test power calculation
# Study design: independent normal means with equal variances
# Hypothesis: one-sided test of superiority

# Parameters from user specification
effect_size_raw <- 4.3    # Expected difference (dBA)
common_sd <- 7.8          # Common standard deviation (dBA)
n_per_group <- 32         # Sample size per group
alpha <- 0.05             # Significance level
sidedness <- 1            # One-sided test
df_error <- 2 * n_per_group - 2  # Degrees of freedom

# Calculate Cohen's d (standardized effect size)
cohens_d <- effect_size_raw / common_sd

# Calculate noncentrality parameter λ
# For equal sample sizes: λ = (μ1 - μ2) / σ * sqrt(n/2)
# Which equals: effect_size / σ * sqrt(n1 * n2 / (n1 + n2))
lambda <- (effect_size_raw / common_sd) * sqrt((n_per_group * n_per_group) / (n_per_group + n_per_group))

# Equivalently for equal n:
lambda_check <- cohens_d * sqrt(n_per_group / 2)

# Critical value for one-sided test at alpha 0.05
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = df_error, ncp = 0)

# Power = P(t > t_crit | H1 true) where t follows noncentral t distribution
power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df = df_error, ncp = lambda)

# Output results
cat("Two-Sample Pooled t-Test Power Calculation\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
cat("Study Design Parameters:\n")
cat("  Expected difference in means:", effect_size_raw, "dBA\n")
cat("  Common standard deviation:", common_sd, "dBA\n")
cat("  Sample size per group:", n_per_group, "\n")
cat("  Total sample size:", 2 * n_per_group, "\n")
cat("  Significance level (alpha):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Sidedness: one-sided\n")
cat("  Degrees of freedom:", df_error, "\n")
cat("\nEffect Size:\n")
cat("  Cohen's d:", round(cohens_d, 6), "\n")
cat("  Noncentrality parameter λ:", round(lambda, 6), "\n")
cat("  Noncentrality check λ:", round(lambda_check, 6), "\n")
cat("\nTest Specification:\n")
cat("  Critical value (t_crit):", round(t_crit, 6), "\n")
cat("  One-sided test: H0: μ1 ≤ μ2 vs H1: μ1 > μ2\n")
cat("\nResults:\n")
cat("  Power:", round(power, 6), "\n")

# Format result for submission
result_power <- power
result_metric <- "power"
result_unit <- "probability"

jsonlite::toJSON(
  list(
    results = list(
      list(metric = result_metric, value = result_power, unit = result_unit)
    )
  ),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  digits = 15
)
